## Stories

### [Leadership] Moving six teams to one release train
**Source:** Report #002 — Globex — Staff DevOps Engineer
**S (Situation):** Six teams shipped on six schedules and broke each other weekly.
**T (Task):** Get them onto one release train without a reorganisation.
**A (Action):** Ran a four-week trial with two volunteer teams and published the results.
**R (Result):** All six teams joined within a quarter; broken releases stopped.
**Reflection:** I would have brought the sceptics into the trial.
**Best for questions about:** leadership, influence without authority

### [Curiosity] A story with no action line
**S (Situation):** career-ops' own readers skip a block without an action.
**R (Result):** So does LVLme.

### [Hobbies] Building a garden shed
**S (Situation):** Rain.
**T (Task):** Shelter.
**A (Action):** Built a shed.
